a.name: Experimental (task resolution with ChatGPT)
a.description: Students solved the mathematical creativity tasks with ChatGPT on personal computers, with technical training and structured example, heuristic, task-reminder, critical-thinking and divergent-thinking prompts. They could ask for solutions and refinements. PDF pp. 5-7 (printed pp. 43-45), Procedure, Figures 1-2 and Table 1. The explicit arm total appears only in Figure 1 and is left null under the figure-only rule.

a.name: Control (task resolution without ChatGPT)
a.description: Students solved the same tasks with traditional tools, such as paper and pencil, without assistance or external prompts. PDF p. 5 (printed p. 43), Figure 1 and Procedure. The explicit arm total appears only in Figure 1 and is left null under the figure-only rule.

b.name: Experimental (task resolution with ChatGPT)
b.description: Students used ChatGPT on personal computers with introductory training and structured example, heuristic, task-reminder, critical-thinking and divergent-thinking prompts. They could iteratively request and refine solutions. PDF pp. 5-7 (printed pp. 43-45), Procedure, Figures 1-2 and Table 1.

b.name: Control (task resolution without ChatGPT)
b.description: Students solved the same tasks using traditional tools such as paper and pencil, without support or external prompts. PDF p. 5 (printed p. 43), Figure 1 and Procedure.
